# duguid.com.au

> duguid.com.au is the site of Ryan Duguid, a senior accountant based in Newcastle, NSW, Australia. He builds open source computational accounting tools and publishes them at github.com/ryanduguid. Ryan Duguid is a Provisional CA ANZ Member. CA ANZ has not endorsed this site or its tools.

Canonical machine index: https://duguid.com.au/llms.txt

Last reviewed 5 November 2026. Page and source-review dates are recorded on the linked pages; this index date does not renew an engine's legal review.

Licence: the site's own text, data and source code are under the Ryan Duguid Public Attribution Licence 1.0, the FSL-1.1-ALv2 text with a public attribution condition and Apache-2.0 as the future licence (https://github.com/ryanduguid/ryanduguid.github.io/blob/main/LICENSE); third-party material named on the pages keeps its own terms.

Identical discovery copy: https://duguid.com.au/.well-known/llms.txt

Ryan Duguid is not a registered tax agent or BAS agent, and nothing here is tax, legal or financial advice. This site is a personal index of open source accounting tools built in Ryan Duguid's own time and on his own equipment. It is not a practice and is not accepting professional engagements through this site. Project support is limited to software issues reproduced with fictional data. Do not send taxpayer information or client files, or request advice, return preparation, tax-treatment confirmation or lodgement.

He is distinct from the United States software product executive Ryan Duguid whose LinkedIn URL has no hyphen.

Written by Ryan Duguid in his own time and on his own equipment. Ryan Duguid is a Provisional CA ANZ Member. CA ANZ has not endorsed this site or its tools. Source repositories: [github.com/ryanduguid](https://github.com/ryanduguid).

The route list below gives the 5 starting routes on the homepage and Tools page, by accounting task.

Every page names the primary source it is grounded in: Commonwealth legislation, ATO rulings and rate schedules, or the accounting standard. Calculation methods and rounding rules are documented with each tool. The browser business loan calculator uses fixed monthly rates and rounds each result to the nearest cent. Lender rounding and daily accrual can differ. Public fixtures and examples use fictional data. Calculation engines run locally. A cloud-backed AI host may send supplied arguments, tool results and library excerpts to its model provider; optional integrations have separate network boundaries. Human review remains mandatory before posting, payment, lodgement, approval or period lock. Figures are free to cite with attribution and should be verified against current guidance before anyone relies on them.

## Choose a route

- [Understand why profit and cash differ](https://duguid.com.au/examples/profit-vs-cash-flow/): Read the fictional cash flow case in your browser: one delayed receipt creates a $25,160 cash gap while quarterly profit stays the same. The Excel workbook is optional.
- [Use accounting functions in Excel](https://duguid.com.au/tools/ozzit/): Try GST, financial year, depreciation and loan examples in Ozzit. It needs Microsoft 365 or Excel 2024 or later.
- [Review a month-end close](https://duguid.com.au/tools/monthly-close-controls/): Inspect eight exceptions in a fictional July close, including a $250 creditors difference. Read the report in your browser; rerunning it needs Git and Rust.
- [Calculate a Coal LSL levy](https://duguid.com.au/tools/coal-lsl-levy/): Calculate eligible wages and see which formula applies. It runs in your browser with nothing to install.
- [Check a BAS pack before manager review](https://duguid.com.au/evaluate/manager-review-gate/): See why a sample pack is sent back for missing work and unresolved items. Read the findings in your browser; rerunning the checks needs Python.

- [Privacy and site use](https://duguid.com.au/privacy/): browser calculations, cookies, hosting, feedback and links to the advice boundaries and software licences.

- [Profit and cash](https://duguid.com.au/examples/profit-vs-cash-flow/): the canonical worked example. A fictional Newcastle service-business forecast in AUD, with a downloadable Excel workbook and its source files. Delaying one $44,000 receipt by 45 days creates a $25,160 daily cash shortfall on 6 November 2026 while quarterly profit before income tax stays $35,957.55. A summary with the same figures remains at https://duguid.com.au/evaluate/#profit-and-cash. No client outcome or time saving is claimed.
- [Adopt](https://duguid.com.au/tools/australian-tax-ai-agents/#install): use the supported install commands for Python packages, the MCP server and agent workflows, and evaluate tools with fictional data.
- [Verify](https://duguid.com.au/evidence/): open Evidence and Assurance for Australian computational accounting tools to inspect identity and credentials; packages, releases and repositories; sources and review dates; data and privacy boundary; security, tests and release evidence; supplier information for AI registers; human accountability and refusals; and reproducible evaluations.

## Works with

- [Works with](https://duguid.com.au/works-with/): choose existing tools by software, starting with Xero and Claude, with prerequisites and read and write boundaries.
- [Works with Xero](https://duguid.com.au/works-with/xero/): read-only trial balance report export to a local CSV, developer app and consent requirements, fictional evaluation and ledger write refusal.
- [Works with Claude](https://duguid.com.au/works-with/claude/): local Aus Accounting MCP in Claude Code or Claude Desktop, preparation skills in Claude Code, runtime requirements and model provider disclosure.

## For AI agents

- [Aus Accounting MCP](https://duguid.com.au/tools/australian-tax-ai-agents/): local MCP server, current release v0.10.0 (19 November 2026). ATO small business benchmarks, Payday Super timing, limited Division 7A review, GST coding and BAS reconciliation review, and 14 bounded tax and super worksheets. Runs locally, ships no ATO document library, prepares or lodges nothing; human review required. Registry name io.github.ryanduguid/aus-accounting. Separate project from ato-mcp.
- [Agent skills manifest](https://duguid.com.au/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json): the 65 released SKILL.md files of australian-accounting-skills v0.4.0, each with its description, a URL that serves the released bytes at the release commit and a sha256 digest to check them against. v0.4.0 is the latest release under Apache-2.0, the licence the manifest declares, so it is pinned; later releases are under other licences, and the Australian Accounting Skills entry below names the current one. Preparation-only workflows in the Agent Skills format; not lodgement.
- [In-page WebMCP tools](https://github.com/ryanduguid/ryanduguid.github.io/blob/main/assets/webmcp-tools.mjs): 22 read-only calculator tools a browser's agent can call through the WebMCP `modelContext` API, each running its page's own calculation and sending nothing off the page: `calculate_gst`, `calculate_div7a_minimum_repayment`, `calculate_loan_schedule`, `calculate_hire_purchase_schedule`, `calculate_lease_schedule`, `calculate_break_even`, `calculate_company_tax`, `calculate_foreign_purchaser_surcharges`, `calculate_long_service_leave`, `calculate_fuel_tax_credits` and `calculate_borrowing_expenses` on their business calculator pages, `estimate_income_tax`, `calculate_take_home_pay`, `calculate_sole_trader_set_aside`, `calculate_division_293_tax`, `calculate_bonus_withholding`, `calculate_income_tests`, `calculate_salary_packaging`, `calculate_novated_lease` and `project_super_balance` on the income tax, take-home pay, sole trader set-aside, Division 293, bonus withholding, income tests, salary packaging, novated lease and super projection calculators, `calculate_decline_in_value` on the depreciation rates page and `calculate_coal_lsl_levy` on the Coal LSL levy calculator. The 6 Ozzit module pages add an `ozzit_function` lookup. Input that does not match a tool's schema is refused, not converted. Browser support, read 15 November 2026: ChromeStatus lists WebMCP as a Chrome developer trial behind a flag from Chrome 146 and an origin trial from Chrome 149 to 156 (an extension to Chrome 162 is also listed), with no signal from Firefox or Safari, and the specification is a W3C Community Group draft of 13 November 2026. The site holds no origin trial token, so the tools appear only in a browser with WebMCP switched on.

## Person

- [About Ryan Duguid](https://duguid.com.au/about/): who he is, where he is, credentials, what the tools are grounded in and how to cite the work. Machine-readable Person data is in the JSON-LD on that page.

## Evaluation packs

- [Evaluations](https://duguid.com.au/evaluate/): index of the three reproducible accounting tool evaluations, their fictional inputs, fixed releases, expected results and limits.
- [Workpaper Review Gate evaluation](https://duguid.com.au/evaluate/manager-review-gate/): reproduces the released review-ready-gate/v0.1.3 result for 2 fictional BAS packs, including the exact NOT_READY findings, corrected READY result and human decision boundary.
- [Xero trial balance integrity evaluation](https://duguid.com.au/evaluate/xero-trial-balance-integrity/): reproduces the movement and YTD balance gate with 3 fictional CSV fixtures, no Xero tenant credentials or tenant data, and an explicit human review boundary.
- [Payday Super timing evidence evaluation](https://duguid.com.au/evaluate/payday-super-evidence/): preserves 4 fictional evidence-timing outcomes from checker 0.1.3, including at-risk, on-time and late classifications, with an explicit human decision boundary. It does not establish that the current release resolves the receipt amount limitation.
- [Payday Super evidence pack workflow](https://duguid.com.au/tools/payday-super/#evidence-pack): the current checker combines report.csv, a SHA-256-bound practitioner checklist, exceptions.json and a blank decision-log.md. The pack omits employee identifiers and queues every non-ON_TIME result. The CLI writes a new directory; MCP returns file contents in memory and accepts no paths. No advice, lodgement or ledger writes.

## Reference tables

- [Rates](https://duguid.com.au/rates/): index of the 12 maintained Australian tax, payroll and duty references, their source-checked dates, primary sources and downloadable CSVs where available.
- [Rate tables JSON](https://duguid.com.au/rates/rates.json): every row of the 11 rate CSVs in one file, each with its primary source URL (`source_url`) and the date it was checked (`checked_at`). Published under this repository's licence, the Ryan Duguid Public Attribution Licence 1.0.
- [Super guarantee rate history](https://duguid.com.au/rates/super-guarantee/): every general SG percentage from 2002-03 to today. The rate has been 12% since 1 July 2025 with no further steps scheduled. From 1 July 2026, Payday Super changed when contributions must be paid, the earnings basis (qualifying earnings rather than ordinary time earnings) and the maximum contributions base treatment; the 12% percentage itself did not change.
- [Super guarantee rate history CSV](https://duguid.com.au/rates/super-guarantee/super-guarantee-rates.csv): machine-readable copy of the maintained table; each row names its primary source URL (`source_url`) and the date it was checked (`checked_at`).
- [Division 7A benchmark interest rate](https://duguid.com.au/rates/div7a-benchmark-rate/): For companies with a 30 June year end: 8.77% for 2026-27, 8.37% for 2025-26. Section 109N(2) ITAA 1936 ties the rate to the Reserve Bank's indicator lending rate for bank variable housing loans, the last figure published before the income year starts, which is the May figure for a 30 June year end. A substituted accounting period uses the last relevant rate published before its own start date.
- [Division 7A benchmark interest rate CSV](https://duguid.com.au/rates/div7a-benchmark-rate/div7a-benchmark-rates.csv): machine-readable copy of the maintained table; each row names its primary source URL (`source_url`) and the date it was checked (`checked_at`).
- [Cents per kilometre rate for car expenses](https://duguid.com.au/rates/cents-per-kilometre/): 91 cents for 2026-27, 88 cents for 2024-25 and 2025-26, capped at the first 5,000 business kilometres per car. One rate for every car, whatever the engine size. The 2026 determination sets 91 cents for that income year alone, so it does not carry into 2027-28 the way the 2024 determination's 88 cents carried into 2025-26.
- [Cents per kilometre rate CSV](https://duguid.com.au/rates/cents-per-kilometre/cents-per-kilometre-rates.csv): machine-readable copy of the maintained table; each row names its primary source URL (`source_url`) and the date it was checked (`checked_at`).
- [Maximum super contribution base](https://duguid.com.au/rates/maximum-contribution-base/): $270,830 of qualifying earnings for 2026-27, an annual figure under Payday Super counted separately by each employer; the quarterly bases for 2021-22 to 2025-26 are listed with the maximum SG each implies. Formula: concessional cap times 100, divided by the charge percentage, rounded down to $10.
- [Maximum super contribution base CSV](https://duguid.com.au/rates/maximum-contribution-base/maximum-contribution-base.csv): machine-readable copy of the maintained table; each row names its primary source URL (`source_url`) and the date it was checked (`checked_at`).
- [Car limit for depreciation](https://duguid.com.au/rates/car-limit/): $69,883 for a car first used or leased in 2026-27, $69,674 for 2025-26 and 2024-25, back to $57,581 for 2019-20, each read from an ATO page. One-eleventh of the limit caps the GST credit ($6,353 for 2026-27).
- [Car limit CSV](https://duguid.com.au/rates/car-limit/car-limit.csv): machine-readable copy of the maintained table; each row names its primary source URL (`source_url`) and the date it was checked (`checked_at`).
- [FBT rate and gross-up rates](https://duguid.com.au/rates/fbt-rate/): 47%, Type 1 gross-up 2.0802 and Type 2 gross-up 1.8868 for every FBT year ending 31 March 2018 to 31 March 2027. Reportable fringe benefits use the Type 2 rate; the reporting threshold is a taxable value above $2,000.
- [FBT rate CSV](https://duguid.com.au/rates/fbt-rate/fbt-rates.csv): machine-readable copy of the maintained table; each row names its primary source URL (`source_url`) and the date it was checked (`checked_at`).
- [General interest charge rate](https://duguid.com.au/rates/general-interest-charge/): 11.51% a year, 0.03153425% a day, for October to December 2026, and every quarter from July 1999, from the ATO. Section 8AAD of the Taxation Administration Act 1953 sets it at the 90-day bank bill yield plus 7 percentage points; GIC compounds daily under section 8AAC.
- [General interest charge rate CSV](https://duguid.com.au/rates/general-interest-charge/general-interest-charge-rates.csv): machine-readable copy of the maintained table; each row names its primary source URL (`source_url`) and the date it was checked (`checked_at`).
- [Individual income tax rates for residents](https://duguid.com.au/rates/individual-income-tax/): 15% on taxable income from $18,201 to $45,000 for 2026-27, then 30%, 37% and 45%, and each resident scale back to 2019-20, read from the ATO. The rates exclude the 2% Medicare levy. Single Medicare levy low-income thresholds from 2020-21 to 2025-26 ($28,011 and $35,013 for 2025-26); the ATO had not published 2026-27 thresholds when checked on 14 November 2026, and the Medicare Levy Act 1986 as compiled on 1 July 2026 applies the 2025-26 figures to later years.
- [Individual income tax rates for residents CSV](https://duguid.com.au/rates/individual-income-tax/individual-income-tax-rates.csv): machine-readable copy of the maintained table; each row names its primary source URL (`source_url`) and the date it was checked (`checked_at`).
- [Study and training loan repayment thresholds](https://duguid.com.au/rates/study-loan-repayment/): $69,528 for 2026-27: 15c for each dollar of repayment income over it, $9,028 plus 17c for each dollar over $129,717, and 10% of the whole repayment income from $186,051. Marginal rates from 2025-26; one rate on the whole repayment income for 2020-21 to 2024-25.
- [Study and training loan repayment thresholds CSV](https://duguid.com.au/rates/study-loan-repayment/study-loan-repayment-thresholds.csv): machine-readable copy of the maintained table; each row names its primary source URL (`source_url`) and the date it was checked (`checked_at`).
- [PAYG withholding: Schedule 1 coefficients](https://duguid.com.au/rates/payg-withholding/): the ATO's Schedule 1 weekly coefficients (y = ax − b) for scales 1, 2 and 3, for payments made from 1 July 2026. Scale 2 has no coefficients below $362 a week. Scales 5 and 6 and the tax tables are not listed.
- [PAYG withholding: Schedule 1 coefficients CSV](https://duguid.com.au/rates/payg-withholding/schedule-1-coefficients.csv): machine-readable copy of the maintained table; each row names its primary source URL (`source_url`) and the date it was checked (`checked_at`).
- [Announced tax measures and enacted law](https://duguid.com.au/rates/announced-not-yet-law/): 27 selected Budget and MYEFO measures. The ATO summary lists 8 as TBD, one as Various and 6 with a bill; those labels do not prove that no draft, bill or instrument exists. Each of those 15 rows records the legislative stage found on 4 November 2026, or that none was identified in the material checked. Twelve rows name enacted legislation, each cited by Act number or Register ID as read on the Federal Register on 13 November 2026; the CSV links the first named on each row. Application dates and transition rules need separate checks.
- [Announced tax measures CSV](https://duguid.com.au/rates/announced-not-yet-law/announced-measures.csv): machine-readable copy of the three tables.
- [Transfer duty (stamp duty) rates by state and territory](https://duguid.com.au/rates/transfer-duty/): the general transfer duty scale of each of the 8 states and territories, read on 15 November 2026 from each revenue office or the legislation. 7% is the top general rate for 2026-27, New South Wales premium duty over $3,870,000. Concessions, first home buyer schemes and foreign purchaser surcharges are not listed.
- [Transfer duty rates CSV](https://duguid.com.au/rates/transfer-duty/transfer-duty-rates.csv): machine-readable copy of the maintained table, one row per band; each row names its primary source URL (`source_url`) and the date it was checked (`checked_at`).

## Browser tools, nothing to install

- [100 Australian accounting questions](https://duguid.com.au/tools/accounting-questions/): practical steps, record checklists, official guidance and existing resources for tax, bookkeeping, cash flow, NSW and Newcastle topics. Search and download selected checklists. Question numbers do not represent measured search demand.
- [Tax returns questions](https://duguid.com.au/tools/accounting-questions/general-tax/): ten of the 100 questions, with steps, records, official guidance and a checklist download. Use the income year and residency facts for the return being prepared.
- [Deductions questions](https://duguid.com.au/tools/accounting-questions/deductions/): ten of the 100 questions, with steps, records, official guidance and a checklist download. Check eligibility and record requirements for the income year of the expense.
- [Starting a business questions](https://duguid.com.au/tools/accounting-questions/business-setup/): ten of the 100 questions, with steps, records, official guidance and a checklist download. Use the entity, activity and income year being assessed.
- [GST and BAS questions](https://duguid.com.au/tools/accounting-questions/gst-bas/): ten of the 100 questions, with steps, records, official guidance and a checklist download. Use the BAS period, GST accounting basis and account due date being reviewed.
- [Payroll and super questions](https://duguid.com.au/tools/accounting-questions/payroll-super/): ten of the 100 questions, with steps, records, official guidance and a checklist download. Use the pay date and applicable payroll rules. Super questions distinguish the regime from July 2026.
- [Bookkeeping and close questions](https://duguid.com.au/tools/accounting-questions/bookkeeping-close/): ten of the 100 questions, with steps, records, official guidance and a checklist download. Use the same reporting date and accounting basis for all reconciliations.
- [Cash flow questions](https://duguid.com.au/tools/accounting-questions/cash-flow/): ten of the 100 questions, with steps, records, official guidance and a checklist download. Planning method for the dates entered. Include obligations in their expected payment weeks.
- [Management reporting questions](https://duguid.com.au/tools/accounting-questions/management-reporting/): ten of the 100 questions, with steps, records, official guidance and a checklist download. Compare the same reporting period and basis; historical benchmarks retain their published years.
- [Companies and trusts questions](https://duguid.com.au/tools/accounting-questions/company-compliance/): ten of the 100 questions, with steps, records, official guidance and a checklist download. Use the entity and relevant income or FBT year; linked tools have separate supported periods.
- [Investments and NSW questions](https://duguid.com.au/tools/accounting-questions/investments-local/): ten of the 100 questions, with steps, records, official guidance and a checklist download. Use the relevant disposal, income or NSW assessment year.
- [Business calculators](https://duguid.com.au/tools/business-calculators/): browser calculations for GST, business use, margins, break-even, hourly pricing, fixed fee pricing with monthly instalments, budget variance, loan and hire purchase or chattel mortgage schedules weekly to yearly with an optional balloon and the rate, amount or term worked out, AASB 16 lease liabilities and right-of-use assets with a lease, hire purchase or buy comparison after GST and tax, Division 7A minimum yearly repayments, Division 7A loan schedules over 7 or 25 years, Division 296 tax on super earnings for 2026-27, FBT on a car by the statutory formula or operating cost method, the taxable value of car parking, loan, meal entertainment, property and expense payment fringe benefits, whether a vehicle is a car for the car limit, GST, luxury car tax and FBT, supplied staff costs, 13-week cash scenarios with CSV export, general transfer duty, foreign purchaser surcharges and annual payroll tax in each state and territory, company tax and franking credits, GST under the margin scheme on a sale of real property, which small business CGT concessions are open for a capital gain, capital gains tax on one sale with the discount, indexation and the main residence exemption, business days between dates, Payday Super due dates with the super guarantee charge, and Schedule 7 withholding from unused leave paid on termination. Planning estimates with visible assumptions; no account access or lodgement.
- [GST calculator](https://duguid.com.au/tools/business-calculators/gst/): Work out GST, the GST-exclusive amount and the GST-inclusive amount for a wholly taxable supply at 10%, rounded once to cents.
- [Business use share calculator](https://duguid.com.au/tools/business-calculators/business-use/): Apportion an eligible cost by a supported business use percentage. It does not decide deductibility, depreciation or record sufficiency.
- [Margin and markup calculator](https://duguid.com.au/tools/business-calculators/margin/): Gross profit, margin and markup from sales and direct cost, on a consistent GST basis and matching period.
- [Break-even sales calculator](https://duguid.com.au/tools/business-calculators/break-even/): Whole units and sales required to cover fixed costs from price and variable cost per unit.
- [Hourly pricing calculator](https://duguid.com.au/tools/business-calculators/hourly/): Required hourly rate before GST from annual costs, target profit and billable hours.
- [Fixed fee pricing calculator](https://duguid.com.au/tools/business-calculators/fixed-fee/): A fixed fee from estimated hours at a rate or a cost and margin, with GST, monthly instalments that add up to the cent and the effective hourly rate.
- [Budget variance calculator](https://duguid.com.au/tools/business-calculators/variance/): Actual minus budget, the percentage of absolute budget and whether the difference is favourable or unfavourable.
- [Loan repayment schedule calculator](https://duguid.com.au/tools/business-calculators/loan/): Every payment of a loan, weekly to yearly, in arrears or in advance, with an optional balloon; works out the payment, the amount, the term or the rate, with CSV export.
- [Hire purchase and chattel mortgage schedule](https://duguid.com.au/tools/business-calculators/hire-purchase/): The same schedule for a hire purchase agreement or chattel mortgage, with the interest by income year and a journal for each payment.
- [AASB 16 lease calculator](https://duguid.com.au/tools/business-calculators/lease/): A lessee’s lease liability and right-of-use asset under AASB 16, with interest, payments, depreciation and balances by income year and the journals, and the same asset on hire purchase or bought outright, after GST and tax, by income year.
- [Borrowing expenses calculator](https://duguid.com.au/tools/business-calculators/borrowing-expenses/): Section 25-25 borrowing expenses by income year from 2017-18, spread by days, with the $100 rule, refinancing and an optional AASB 9 column.
- [Division 7A loan calculator](https://duguid.com.au/tools/business-calculators/div7a/): Minimum yearly repayment, interest and principal on one amalgamated loan.
- [FBT car calculator](https://duguid.com.au/tools/business-calculators/fbt-car/): Taxable value and FBT on one car for the FBT year ending 31 March 2027, by the statutory formula or the operating cost method, with the electric cars exemption checked condition by condition.
- [FBT car parking calculator](https://duguid.com.au/tools/business-calculators/fbt-car-parking/): Whether car parking fringe benefits arise against the $11.48 threshold, and their taxable value by any of the 5 methods, for the FBT year ending 31 March 2027.
- [FBT expense payment calculator](https://duguid.com.au/tools/business-calculators/fbt-expense-payment/): Taxable value of an expense payment fringe benefit, external with the otherwise deductible rule or in-house by the in-house rules, for the FBT year ending 31 March 2027.
- [FBT loan calculator](https://duguid.com.au/tools/business-calculators/fbt-loan/): Taxable value of a loan fringe benefit at the 8.27% statutory interest rate, with the otherwise deductible rule, for the FBT year ending 31 March 2027.
- [Meal entertainment calculator](https://duguid.com.au/tools/business-calculators/fbt-meal-entertainment/): Taxable value of meal entertainment fringe benefits by the 50/50 split or 12-week register method, for the FBT year ending 31 March 2027.
- [FBT property calculator](https://duguid.com.au/tools/business-calculators/fbt-property/): Taxable value of a property fringe benefit by the in-house or external rules, with the otherwise deductible rule and the $1,000 in-house reduction, for the FBT year ending 31 March 2027.
- [Vehicle classifier](https://duguid.com.au/tools/business-calculators/vehicle-class/): Whether a vehicle is a car, and what follows for the car limit, the GST credit, luxury car tax, FBT and records.
- [PCG 2021/4 risk scorer](https://duguid.com.au/tools/business-calculators/pcg-2021-4/): The ATO’s risk zone for a professional firm profit allocation, after both gateways.
- [PCG 2021/4 allocation](https://duguid.com.au/tools/business-calculators/pcg-2021-4-allocation/): Each recipient’s tax on a professional firm’s profit, the effective tax rate and the ATO’s risk zone.
- [GIC payment plan calculator](https://duguid.com.au/tools/business-calculators/gic-payment-plan/): What a tax debt costs by equal instalments, against paying it now, with GIC compounding daily.
- [Division 7A loan schedule calculator](https://duguid.com.au/tools/business-calculators/div7a-schedule/): A complying Division 7A loan year by year over 7 or 25 years: each minimum repayment, the interest, extra repayments and any shortfall taken to be a dividend.
- [Division 296 tax calculator](https://duguid.com.au/tools/business-calculators/division-296/): One person’s Division 296 tax on superannuation earnings for 2026-27, above $3 million and above $10 million.
- [Small business CGT concessions checker](https://duguid.com.au/tools/business-calculators/cgt-concessions/): Which of the 4 small business CGT concessions in Division 152 are open for one capital gain on a sale contract to 30 June 2027: the basic conditions, the 15-year exemption, the 50% active asset reduction, the retirement exemption and the roll-over, each with its provision.
- [PSI rules checker](https://duguid.com.au/tools/business-calculators/psi-determination/): Whether the personal services income rules apply, step by step through Divisions 84 to 87.
- [Company tax and franking calculator](https://duguid.com.au/tools/business-calculators/company-tax/): A company’s 25% or 30% rate from the base rate entity test, its rate for franking dividends, the maximum franking credit and a shareholder’s tax or refund.
- [Capital gains tax calculator](https://duguid.com.au/tools/business-calculators/cgt/): The capital gain or loss on one sale with a contract from 1 July 2020 to 30 June 2027, for a resident individual, trust, super fund or company: cost base, the discount or indexation, capital losses, the main residence exemption with the 6-year absence rule and section 118-192, and the question 18 labels.
- [Staff cost calculator](https://duguid.com.au/tools/business-calculators/staff/): Annual and monthly cost of a staff member from wages, the supplied super amount and other annual costs.
- [13-week cash forecast](https://duguid.com.au/tools/business-calculators/cash/): Weekly closing cash from opening cash, receipts and payments, with one delayed receipt and a funding gap against a buffer. Save, load and export as CSV.
- [SGC and Payday Super due date calculator](https://duguid.com.au/tools/business-calculators/sgc-payday/): When a Payday Super contribution is due in business days, how many days late it was, and one employee’s super guarantee charge, under Payday Super or for a quarter to June 2026.
- [Long service leave calculator](https://duguid.com.au/tools/business-calculators/long-service-leave/): One employee’s long service leave under the Act of any of the 8 states and territories: the qualifying period, the leave to take now and when more becomes available, or the weeks payable when employment ends for a given reason, less leave taken, and their value at the weekly pay.
- [Workers compensation premium calculator](https://duguid.com.au/tools/business-calculators/workers-compensation/): A 2026-27 workers compensation premium under each state and territory’s scheme, from the declared wages and the rate the insurer sets: each scheme’s small employer method, GST, Queensland’s duty and the adjustment to actual wages. It holds no rate table and refuses experience-rated premiums.
- [Objection deadline checker](https://duguid.com.au/tools/business-calculators/objection-deadline/): The last day to object to an income tax or FBT assessment, an amended assessment or another ATO decision, with the weekend rule.
- [PAYG instalments calculator](https://duguid.com.au/tools/business-calculators/payg-instalments/): The quarterly PAYG instalment from the notified amount, a varied amount, instalment income times the rate, or a varied rate with its credit.
- [Fuel tax credit calculator](https://duguid.com.au/tools/business-calculators/fuel-tax-credits/): A business’s fuel tax credits at the ATO’s rate for each day since 1 July 2022, by fuel and use, with label 7D and the small claimant methods.
- [Redundancy and ETP withholding](https://duguid.com.au/tools/business-calculators/termination-payment/): The tax-free part of a genuine redundancy payment and the amount to withhold from an ETP under Schedule 11, for 2026-27.
- [Unused leave on termination](https://duguid.com.au/tools/business-calculators/unused-leave/): Schedule 7 withholding and the lump sum A, B and type U amounts for unused leave paid on termination, for 2026-27.
- [Land tax calculator](https://duguid.com.au/tools/business-calculators/land-tax/): Land tax for a full year in each of the 7 states and territories that levy it, at the general or trust rates, with a foreign or absentee owner surcharge and WA's metropolitan region improvement tax where chosen, before any exemption. The Northern Territory has no land tax.
- [Transfer duty calculator](https://duguid.com.au/tools/business-calculators/transfer-duty/): General transfer (stamp) duty on a residential purchase in each of the 8 states and territories, and the duty for an eligible first home buyer of a home.
- [Payroll tax calculator](https://duguid.com.au/tools/business-calculators/payroll-tax/): One employer’s annual payroll tax for 2026-27 in any state or territory, for an employer outside a group, with each deduction, rate, surcharge and levy cited.
- [Foreign purchaser surcharge calculator](https://duguid.com.au/tools/business-calculators/foreign-surcharge/): Foreign purchaser duty and the foreign owner land tax surcharge in each state and territory, with each one’s own test of who is foreign.
- [Business days calculator](https://duguid.com.au/tools/business-calculators/business-days/): Business days between 2 dates, or the date a number of business days on or back, with each state’s public holidays for 2026 and 2027.
- [GST margin scheme calculator](https://duguid.com.au/tools/business-calculators/gst-margin-scheme/): Whether the margin scheme can apply to a sale of land, a stratum unit or a long-term lease under GST Act s 75-5, the margin by consideration or approved valuation with a subdivided lot's share, its GST and the GST it saves.
- [Individual tax calculators](https://duguid.com.au/tools/individual-tax/): browser calculations of one person's income tax with a refund estimate, take-home pay with salary sacrifice and PAYG withholding from 2021-22, study and training loan repayment, and a sole trader's tax and GST set-aside, from 2020-21 to 2026-27, Division 293 tax from 2021-22, the PAYG withheld from a 2026-27 bonus or back payment, salary packaging and a novated lease with their FBT and reportable amounts, and the lump sum in arrears tax offset and the income tests behind the surcharge, offsets and study loans for 2024-25 to 2026-27, the concessional contributions cap with unused cap carried forward for 2024-25 to 2026-27, and a super projection to retirement, each from the Act or the ATO's published schedules, with the ATO's worked examples among the tested cases. Not advice.
- [Income tax calculator](https://duguid.com.au/tools/individual-tax/income-tax/): Income tax for an Australian resident, foreign resident or working holiday maker from 2020-21 to 2026-27: the low income tax offset, the low and middle income tax offset for 2020-21 and 2021-22, the Medicare levy with its low-income reduction, the Medicare levy surcharge for a single person or a family, any study loan repayment and the refund or amount owing on the tax withheld.
- [Take-home pay calculator](https://duguid.com.au/tools/individual-tax/take-home-pay/): From an annual salary with or without super: the year's tax after the 2026-27 standard deduction, Medicare levy and study loan repayment, net pay a year, month, fortnight and week, and the employer's super guarantee. It takes off salary sacrificed to super and, for a weekly, fortnightly or monthly pay from 2021-22, gives the PAYG withheld under that year's Schedules 1 and 8 (scale 2 or 3; none for a working holiday maker), with the 2025-26 study loan component before 24 September 2025 beside the later one. Any surcharge is a single person's.
- [Study and training loan calculator](https://duguid.com.au/tools/individual-tax/study-loan/): Repayment income from its 5 parts and the compulsory HELP or other study loan repayment, marginal from 2025-26 under HESA s 154-20.
- [Sole trader tax set-aside calculator](https://duguid.com.au/tools/individual-tax/sole-trader/): What a resident sole trader keeps from each invoice and each quarter, month and week for 2021-22 to 2026-27: the income tax, Medicare levy, any surcharge and study loan repayment that the business profit adds to any wages, after the small business income tax offset worked as ITAA 1997 s 328-360 sets it (16% of the profit's share of the tax, at most $1,000), plus GST less GST credits when registered. It refuses a business loss.
- [Lump sum in arrears tax offset calculator](https://duguid.com.au/tools/individual-tax/lump-sum-arrears/): The tax offset for lump sum payments in arrears under ITAA 1936 ss 159ZR to 159ZRD for a resident's year of receipt from 2024-25 to 2026-27: the 10% test, the tax on the arrears, each recent accrual year's notional tax at its rates from 2012-13 and the distant years' at the average rate.
- [Division 293 tax calculator](https://duguid.com.au/tools/individual-tax/division-293/): The 15% Division 293 tax on concessional contributions above the $250,000 threshold for 2021-22 to 2026-27, from Division 293 income, excess concessional contributions and unused cap carried forward under ITAA 1997 ss 291-20 and 293-20.
- [Income tests calculator](https://duguid.com.au/tools/individual-tax/income-tests/): The 6 income measures one resident's tax return feeds for 2024-25 to 2026-27: income for surcharge purposes, Division 293 income, rebate income, repayment income, adjusted taxable income and co-contribution total income, each from its Act. It works the measures, not the offsets or levies they test.
- [Concessional catch-up calculator](https://duguid.com.au/tools/individual-tax/concessional-catch-up/): The concessional contributions cap for 2024-25 to 2026-27 with each earlier year's unused cap from 2018-19 carried forward under ITAA 1997 s 291-20, applied earliest year first below a $500,000 balance, with any excess and the year each amount lapses. It refuses a defined benefit interest.
- [Super projection calculator](https://duguid.com.au/tools/individual-tax/super-projection/): One accumulation account from 2026-27 to retirement at 67 or another age, in future dollars and at its present value at 3.7% a year (ASIC Instrument 2022/603 s 4), with the super guarantee, 15% contributions tax, fees and premiums, and every assumption stated and changeable; general information, not advice.
- [Bonus withholding calculator](https://duguid.com.au/tools/individual-tax/bonus-withholding/): The PAYG withheld from a 2026-27 weekly, fortnightly or monthly pay that includes a bonus, commission or back payment, by Schedule 5's Method A, B(i) or B(ii), with the Schedule 8 study loan component and the 47% limit; it reproduces the ATO's 4 worked examples and gives the tax a Method A payment adds to the year.
- [Salary packaging calculator](https://duguid.com.au/tools/individual-tax/salary-packaging/): Packaging with a public benevolent institution, health promotion charity, hospital or ambulance service for 2022-23 to 2026-27: the $30,000 or $17,000 grossed-up cap, the $5,000 meal entertainment allowance and FBT on the excess (FBTAA ss 5B and 57A), the reportable amount (s 135Q) and the tax saved.
- [Novated lease calculator](https://duguid.com.au/tools/individual-tax/novated-lease/): A year of a novated car lease for 2023-24 to 2026-27 against paying from after-tax pay: whether the electric car exemption (FBTAA s 8A) applies, the reportable statutory formula value, and the employee contribution method with GST.
- [Payday Super receipt evidence](https://duguid.com.au/tools/payday-super/): fixed fictional $120 contribution, timely remittance and no recorded fund receipt. The pinned 0.1.3 engine returns AT_RISK with a 17 August 2026 deadline. No installation, uploads or recalculation; source and full evaluation links are on the page.
- [Payday Super business days](https://duguid.com.au/tools/payday-super/business-days/): the 17 weekdays from 1 July 2026 to 31 August 2027 that are public holidays for the whole of a state or territory, so not business days for any employer under SGAA s 6(1). Copied from the payday-super-checker calendar at australian-accounting commit 701b3d4; each date was checked against the ATO and the official pages of all 8 states and territories on 14 November 2026. Weekends, part-day and regional holidays are left out.
- [Payday Super business days CSV](https://duguid.com.au/tools/payday-super/business-days/payday-super-business-days.csv): machine-readable copy of the table; each row gives the date, weekday, holiday names, jurisdictions and the date it was checked (`checked_at`).
- [BAS due dates for 2026-27](https://duguid.com.au/tools/bas-due-dates/): monthly BAS due on the 21st of the following month and quarterly BAS on 28 October, 28 February, 28 April and 28 July, with the ATO's 2-week online dates (11 November, 12 May, 11 August) and the BAS agent lodgment program dates (25 November, 21 February for December monthly, 26 May and 25 August, which the ATO marks to be confirmed). Each date was checked at its ATO page on 15 November 2026. Dates are shown as published; the ATO allows until the next business day when one falls on a weekend or public holiday.
- [BAS due dates CSV](https://duguid.com.au/tools/bas-due-dates/bas-due-dates-2026-27.csv): one row per month or quarter of 2026-27, with each due date, the agent date's status, the ATO page behind each date and the date the row was checked (`checked_at`).
- [Depreciation rates and effective lives](https://duguid.com.au/tools/depreciation-rates/): search or browse the 7,430 effective lives in the Commissioner of Taxation's Income Tax Assessment (Effective Life of Depreciating Assets) Determination 2025 (LI 2025/20, F2025L01097, registered 15 September 2025), each with its prime cost and diminishing value rates and the date it was last set, and work out a year's decline in value and deduction from a cost, a life, a start date and a taxable use percentage, by either method or both side by side. It gives the Commissioner's lives; it does not decide which row an asset falls under or whether a deduction is available.
- [Effective life pages](https://duguid.com.au/tools/depreciation-rates/llms.txt): a page for each of the 7,430 effective lives, grouped by Table A industry and Table B asset; that file lists the index and group pages, and each group page links its rows.
- [Effective life tables JSON](https://duguid.com.au/tools/depreciation-rates/effective-life.json): machine-readable copy of Schedule 2 of the determination: 9,311 rows in the instrument's order, each with its depth, description, life in years and in months, flags and the date last set, with the source, its registration date and the date it was read (`source.read`).
- [Tools](https://duguid.com.au/tools/): index of 12 open source accounting controls grouped by extract, calculate, control and inspect, with delivery types, source repositories and human review boundaries.
- [Coal LSL levy calculator](https://duguid.com.au/tools/coal-lsl-levy/): answers which wages are eligible for the 2.7% payroll levy under section 3B of the *Coal Mining Industry (Long Service Leave) Payroll Levy Collection Act 1992*, across the base rate, annual salary and casual branches. Explains the questions this calculator does not resolve and the statutory rules relevant to them.
- [Coal LSL levy API](https://coal-lsl-levy.coal-lsl-levy-service.workers.dev/openapi.json): the same calculation as JSON over HTTP, with no key or sign-up; this OpenAPI 3.1 document describes every route, and `GET https://coal-lsl-levy.coal-lsl-levy-service.workers.dev/v1/calculators` lists the calculator, its supported months and the path to post a calculation to.

## Tool guides, open source, install and run locally

- [Ozzit](https://duguid.com.au/tools/ozzit/): an Excel workbook of 150 native LAMBDA functions and 5 help tables for Australian financial modelling, covering GST at 10%, 1 July financial year labels and periods, budget variance, modelling depreciation schedules, amortisation, ratios and AASB 16 lessee schedules. Current release v3.6.0, published 14 November 2026. Needs Microsoft 365 or Excel 2024 or later; LibreOffice and older Excel cannot evaluate the functions. Ryan Duguid Public Attribution Licence 1.0 from v3.6.0; v3.5.0 stays under the Apache License 2.0. It calculates only: the reviewer decides the accounting treatment, and it contains no income tax, Medicare levy or Division 7A calculations.
- [Ozzit Dates functions](https://duguid.com.au/tools/ozzit/functions/dates/): signatures, parameters, notes and worked examples, taken from each function's help in the released source. The 6 module pages cover all 155 v3.6.0 named formulas (150 LAMBDA functions and 5 help tables).
- [Ozzit Essentials functions](https://duguid.com.au/tools/ozzit/functions/essentials/): the same reference for the Essentials module.
- [Ozzit Financial functions](https://duguid.com.au/tools/ozzit/functions/financial/): the same reference for the Financial module.
- [Ozzit Ratios functions](https://duguid.com.au/tools/ozzit/functions/ratios/): the same reference for the Ratios module.
- [Ozzit Utilities functions](https://duguid.com.au/tools/ozzit/functions/utilities/): the same reference for the Utilities module.
- [Ozzit Debt functions](https://duguid.com.au/tools/ozzit/functions/debt/): the same reference for the Debt module.
- [Ozzit function reference data](https://duguid.com.au/assets/ozzit-function-reference-v3.6.0.json): the same reference as JSON.

- [Monthly Close Controls](https://duguid.com.au/tools/monthly-close-controls/): compares current and prior Xero-shaped trial balance CSVs and prepares an exception report for human review. The pinned fictional example returns REVIEW with 8 exceptions and 6 draft client queries. It reads local files and cannot approve a close.

- [Workpaper Review Gate](https://duguid.com.au/tools/workpaper-review-gate/): local readiness gate for BAS, month-end and year-end folders. A missing artefact or unbalanced trial balance is sent back to the preparer. READY is not sign-off.
- [Xero trial balance CSV export tool](https://duguid.com.au/tools/xero-trial-balance/): pulls the trial balance from the Xero reporting API and refuses to write a file unless the month movement and the year-to-date figures both balance. Read-only scope.
- [ATO small business benchmark comparison tool](https://duguid.com.au/tools/ato-benchmarks/): maps a profit and loss to the ATO benchmark categories and shows whether each ratio falls inside the published range. Runs offline with no network call.
- [TheWIPTally construction WIP schedule](https://duguid.com.au/tools/wip-schedule/): deterministic AASB 15 cost-to-cost WIP from a contract CSV. Contract assets and liabilities are per contract and never netted. Review aid, not a determination.
- [Subcontractor ledger skills for construction and mining](https://duguid.com.au/tools/subcontractor-ledgers/): agent skills for progress claims, retentions, work in progress under AASB 15, fuel tax credits, the Coal LSL levy and payroll tax on contractors. Needs an AI coding agent to run. The skills assemble the contract CSV; TheWIPTally computes the schedule.
- [Trust distribution worksheets for professional review](https://duguid.com.au/tools/trust-distributions/): classifies a distribution against the PCG 2022/2 zones, which are white, green and red only, works out proportionate Division 6 shares following Bamford and calculates a section 99B amount.
- [Company tax and franking worksheets](https://duguid.com.au/tools/company-tax-franking/): base rate entity test, franking account ledger, franking deficit tax and the Division 203 benchmark rule.

## Refusals

- [What these tools refuse](https://duguid.com.au/tools/refusals/): each send-back and refusal the tools give, with the exact command output and exit code from fictional fixtures at the released versions where a command exists, the human step that follows and the refusal scenarios quoted from the external DrDebits guide on GitHub, which is not one of the site's tools.

## Known limitations

- [Known limitations](https://duguid.com.au/tools/limitations/): a refusal is a question handed back; a limitation is an answer that rests on something the reader should be told. Each entry below is declared at runtime by the tool that carries it and is bound to that behaviour by a test in its package, with a `LIMITATIONS.md` in each package. An absent entry means nothing has been established and recorded, not that a tool is correct everywhere else.
- [Payday Super receipt amount rules](https://duguid.com.au/tools/payday-super/#receipt-amount): current checker v0.2.3 requires amount evidence for a timely receipt. A timely receipt date without an amount remains UNKNOWN. A late receipt without an amount remains LATE, with no shortfall reduction and an estimate measured to the as-at date. Historical reports may assume full receipt when an amount is missing. Obtain the receipt amount and rerun the current checker. Reconcile supplied matches before relying on a verdict.

- [PSC-1, payday-super-checker/v0.1.4, narrowed in v0.1.6](https://duguid.com.au/tools/limitations/#psc-1): where a notional earnings period runs past the last quarter in the general interest charge table, a default run withholds that row's SG charge exposure and says so; `--allow-stale-gic` carries the last known rate forward instead. Verdicts, deadlines, business-day arithmetic and the SG shortfall never read the rate table. The MCP server has no such option. Update the rate table from the ATO general interest charge rates page rather than passing the flag.
- [PSC-2, payday-super-checker/v0.1.4](https://duguid.com.au/tools/limitations/#psc-2): 4 column conditions (a blank employee id, no payroll pay-period-end column, only one super pay period column, or no super pay period columns) degrade the payroll-to-super join, so a verdict can be wrong with no arithmetic being wrong. Each is declared as a structural warning. In 0.1.4 those warnings are console-only; from 0.1.5 (20 September 2026) they are also written to the contributions CSV, the report and the evidence pack.
- [ABC-1, ato-benchmark-compare/v0.1.7](https://duguid.com.au/tools/limitations/#abc-1): a ratio whose buckets were not supplied is shown as a computed figure, typically 0.0000, by the command line text and JSON, while the Python library withholds it as not_supplied, and the cost of sales key ratio fallback differs between them. Release 0.1.8 (20 September 2026) gates the command line on the supplied buckets, so both paths read not_supplied.

## Source code

- [planning-analytics-model](https://github.com/ryanduguid/planning-analytics-model): an IBM Planning Analytics budget model with an offline Rust rule evaluator. The model uses fictional data.
- [au-accounting-hotkeys](https://github.com/ryanduguid/au-accounting-hotkeys): Windows AutoHotkey v2 shortcuts for Australian workpaper dates, period labels and draft snippets. Review generated text before using it in a workpaper.
- [Australian Accounting](https://github.com/ryanduguid/australian-accounting): maintained home for the local MCP application and the independently versioned Australian accounting engines.
- [Accounting Review Pipeline](https://github.com/ryanduguid/accounting-review-pipeline): maintained home for Xero exports, readiness and close-review controls, the Excel toolkit and the Power BI project. Each component keeps its own distribution, commands and licence.
- [Australian Accounting Skills](https://github.com/ryanduguid/australian-accounting-skills): current release v0.6.0 (12 November 2026) contains 107 workflows under the Ryan Duguid Public Attribution Licence 1.0, including the 10 construction and mining subcontractor workflows. Of its 235 validation cards, 95 have human-confirmed results. The recorded whole-card runs measure adherence to visible instructions, not source retrieval. Development also has task-only observations whose human verdicts remain pending. Adopt installs v0.4.0, which contains 65 workflows under Apache-2.0, including 9 public practice and 10 construction and mining subcontractor workflows, and 83 validation cards. The contracting workflows are included in this unified pack.
- [DrDebits](https://github.com/ryanduguid/DrDebits): external guide repository, not in the site tool register and with no page on this site. It holds the DrDebits prompt guide, APES 110 and TPB guardrails, refusal scenarios and recorded model evaluations. An authorised human remains responsible for professional judgements and actions.
- [github.com/ryanduguid](https://github.com/ryanduguid): every tool on this site, plus the MCP server, the Claude Code skills, the Excel LAMBDA library and the Power Query utilities.
- [Related resources](https://duguid.com.au/tools/#related-resources): third-party libraries, ATO guidance and Commonwealth legislation sources this work depends on or sits beside.

## Reuse

- [Reusing this code](https://github.com/ryanduguid/ryanduguid.github.io/blob/main/AGENTS.md#reusing-this-code): Ryan Duguid's work under the Ryan Duguid Public Attribution Licence, Version 1.0 (LicenseRef-Duguid-Public-Attribution-1.0), which is FSL-1.1-ALv2 plus a public attribution condition; keep its notices and licence; where the Public Attribution Condition applies, a copy or port made available outside the user's organisation must credit Ryan Duguid publicly.

## Optional

- [Crawler policy](https://duguid.com.au/robots.txt): search and user-requested citation fetches remain allowed, including Google-Extended. No crawler is blocked. Every other agent may also crawl, training crawlers included, whether the file names them or not; it names Common Crawl (CCBot), Bytespider, GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Applebot-Extended, Amazonbot, cohere-ai, Diffbot, FacebookBot and meta-externalagent. Permission does not guarantee a crawl, dataset inclusion or use by a model.
